title: ध्रुव नाटकमा प्रभुत्व, प्रतिरोध र प्रतिप्रभुत्व
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा बालकृष्ण समको पौराणिक कथावस्तुमा आधारित 'ध्रुव’ नाटकमा प्रभुत्व, प्रतिरोध र प्रतिप्रभुत्वको अवस्था ठम्याइएको छ । एन्टोनियो ग्राम्सीको प्रभुत्वसम्बन्धी अवधारणाका आधारमा 'ध्रुव’ नाटकका चरित्रहरूलाई केलाई अहिंसात्मक किसिमले सहमतीय आधारमा तिनमा भएको न्यायिक परिवर्तनलाई यस आलेखले आफ्नो अध्ययनको विषय बनाएको छ । उक्त नाटकका नायक ध्रुवले दमित र अपहेलित अवस्थाबाट मुक्ति पाउन केकस्तो प्रतिरोध एवं पराभौतिक अभ्यास गरी प्रभुत्वशाली अवस्थामा पुगेर आफ्नो उद्देश्यमा सफल भए भन्ने कुरा देखाउनु यस आलेखको उद्देश्य हो । कसैलाई क्षति नपु¥याई सत्यनिष्ठ भएर वैयक्तिक प्रयास र आध्यात्मिक साधनाबाट शक्ति आर्जन गर्न सकिन्छ र उत्पीडित स्थितिबाट प्रभुत्वशाली अवस्थामा पुग्न सकिन्छ भन्नु यस नाटकको प्राप्ति हो । पौराणिक कथावस्तु भए पनि आधुनिक सिद्धान्तका सापेक्षतामा हेर्दा अहिंसा, शान्ति, सत्यनिष्ठा, शिष्ट विद्रोह र निरन्तर प्रयासले पनि शक्ति आर्जन गर्न सकिन्छ भन्ने कुरा जे जसरी देखाइएको छ, त्यो वर्तमान समाजका लागि समेत मार्गदर्शक छ भन्नु 'ध्रुव’ नाटकको निष्कर्ष हो र सोही निष्कर्षको पुष्टि यस आलेखमा गरिएको छ । यसमा गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान ढाँचा र पाठविश्लेषण विधिको अवलम्बन गरी सामग्री–विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In the present study, the state of hegemony, resistance and counter-hegemony in Balakrishna Sama's play 'Dhruva', based on a mythological subject matter, has been identified. On the basis of Antonio Gramsci's concept of hegemony, this article has made its subject the just transformation that occurred in the characters of the play 'Dhruva', examining them in a non-violent manner on a consensual basis. The objective of this article is to show how the hero Dhruva of that play, in order to gain liberation from a suppressed and humiliated state, carried out what kind of resistance and metaphysical practice, reached a hegemonic position and succeeded in his objective. It is the achievement of this play that power can be acquired through truthful individual effort and spiritual practice without harming anyone, and that one can reach a hegemonic position from an oppressed situation. Even though it is a mythological subject matter, seen in relation to modern theory, the fact that power can be acquired through non-violence, peace, truthfulness, civil rebellion and continuous effort, as shown in whatever way, is the conclusion of the play 'Dhruva' and the same conclusion has been substantiated in this article. Qualitative research design and the text analysis method have been adopted in this, and content analysis has been carried out.
british_english: In the present study, the state of hegemony, resistance and counter-hegemony in Balakrishna Sama's play 'Dhruva', based on a mythological theme, has been ascertained. Drawing on Antonio Gramsci's concept of hegemony, this paper has taken as its subject the just transformation that took place in the characters of the play 'Dhruva', sifting them in a non-violent manner on a consensual basis. The aim of this paper is to show how the hero Dhruva of that play, in order to gain release from a suppressed and despised condition, undertook what manner of resistance and metaphysical practice, attained a hegemonic position and succeeded in his purpose. The gain of this play is that power can be acquired through truthful personal effort and spiritual discipline without injuring anyone, and that one can rise from an oppressed situation to a hegemonic position. Although it is a mythological theme, viewed in relation to modern theory, the fact that power can be acquired through non-violence, peace, truthfulness, polite rebellion and sustained effort, as depicted in whatever way, is the conclusion of the play 'Dhruva', and that conclusion has been verified in this paper. A qualitative research design and the text analysis method have been adopted in this, and a content analysis has been carried out.

Its aim is to show how the hero Dhruva, to free himself from a suppressed and humiliated state, carried out what kind of resistance and metaphysical practice, reached a hegemonic position and succeeded in his goal. Qualitative research design and text analysis method were adopted here, and content analysis was carried out.
